function: Make qualitative analysis of chest X-ray findings
input: Chest X-ray image(s), text, or multi-modal input
output: Qualitative analysis or description of certain radiographic features

function: Detect and localise regions in chest X-ray via phrase grounding. Can directly localise disease-related regions for: atelectasis, cardiomegaly, consolidation, edema, lung opacity, pleural effusion, pneumonia, pneumothorax, supporting device. Can also localise anatomical structures such as heart, lung, trachea, mediastinum, diaphragm, hila, etc.
input: Chest X-ray image and a phrase describing the target (disease name or anatomical structure)
output: Bounding box coordinates of the detected region, saved as an image with drawn bounding box

function: Segment anatomical structures (lungs, heart, mediastinum, etc.) in chest X-ray. NOTE: can ONLY segment organs and anatomical structures, NOT lesions or disease regions directly. MUST receive a bounding box from the grounding model (tool 2) as input prompt — cannot run on raw image alone.
input: Chest X-ray image AND bounding box from grounding model (tool 2) as prompt
output: Segmentation mask of the target anatomical structure, saved as an image file

function: Write and execute code for quantitative indicator computation (e.g., cardiothoracic ratio, area measurements)
input: Segmentation masks or bounding boxes from prior steps
output: Numerical indicator values saved to diagnosis.json
